# MESA — Memory Engine for Structured Agents

[![MESA CI](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/actions/workflows/ci.yml?query=branch%3Amain)
[![Codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/Yasou13/MESA/graph/badge.svg)](https://codecov.io/gh/Yasou13/MESA)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Yasou13/MESA)](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/releases/latest)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Yasou13/MESA)](LICENSE)
[![Python: 3.10+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.10%2B-3776AB?logo=python&logoColor=white)](pyproject.toml)

MESA Core stores source-backed agent memory and retrieves scoped evidence over
HTTP, Python clients and MCP. SQLite owns the catalog, assertions, mutation
ledger and artifact ownership; LanceDB and Kùzu provide derived projections.

The package version is **0.8.0**. The repository owner approved publication
with the limitations in the [release notes](docs/core/release-notes/).
Production qualification remains at the release candidate stage: `NO-GO` until the
[required release gates](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/docs/release.md) pass on the intended release commit.
Check published versions in [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/releases).

The Codecov badge reflects the latest report available on Codecov. The current
CI workflow saves coverage reports as GitHub Actions artifacts without uploading
them to Codecov; the [v0.8.0 CI coverage run](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/actions/runs/38783424143)
measured **87%** for the core and SDK suite on Python 3.10 and 3.13.

## Getting started

Python 3.10–3.13 are the CI matrix; the project declares Python >=3.10.
Use the checked-in lockfile:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA.git
cd MESA
uv sync --locked --extra dev
uv pip check
```

Follow the [disposable local quickstart](docs/core/getting-started/) for credential
and ACL provisioning, scoped insert, terminal-state polling, retrieval and
restart. Model-disabled operation demonstrates V3 storage and lexical behavior;
it does not measure embedding quality or LLM extraction. Full provider setup
is in [installation](docs/core/installation/) and [configuration](docs/core/configuration/).

### Safe core Compose

Provision `MESA_API_KEY` and `MESA_PRINCIPAL_ID` through your reviewed secret
environment before starting the separate V3 API/worker topology:

```bash
docker compose config --quiet
docker compose up --build -d
curl --fail -H "X-API-Key: $MESA_API_KEY" http://localhost:8000/health
```

Compose sets `MESA_MODEL_ENABLED=false` and
`MESA_EXTERNAL_PROVIDER_ENABLED=false`. Create an authorized session through
`/v3/memory/session/start` before writing. For an already authorized
`analyst_1` record with returned log ID 1, the status URL pattern is
`/v3/memory/status/1?agent_id=analyst_1`; substitute your actual actor and log ID.
This example does not promise a download/build duration.

### Full cognitive runtime

V4 uses `docker-compose.v4.yml` with one combined owner, model-enabled canonical
processing, reviewed providers and matching embedding identity. Follow the
provider prerequisites in [installation](docs/core/installation/); model-disabled
boot rejects V4 inserts with `503 canonical_processing_unavailable`.

## Architecture overview

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Client[Principal-bound session] --> Admission[Canonical mutation admission]
    Admission --> Validation[Selected validation policy]
    Validation --> SQL[SQLite canonical ledger and assertions]
    SQL --> Vector[LanceDB projection]
    Vector --> Graph[Kùzu projection]
    Graph --> Commit[COMMITTED]
    Search[Authorized scoped search] --> Lanes[Vector / BM25 / assertion / graph]
    Lanes --> RRF[Weighted rank fusion and bounded legal factor]
    RRF --> Context[Evidence packing and token budget]
```

V4 runs one `combined` storage owner per root. Sessions bind a principal,
tenant, workspace, agent and immutable dataset set. Validation is selectable:
deterministic-only (0), single LLM (1), or dual LLM consensus (2). Model consensus
does not prove source truth or legal correctness.

`FactExtractionService` owns canonical V4 extraction; REBEL is not part of
canonical V4 extraction.

### Legacy/V3 CPU-Only REBEL Extraction

REBEL is a legacy V3 opt-in using the ML extra. Its CPU cost and language/model
behavior require deployment-specific measurement; no current latency or model
quality result is claimed here.

Search combines four evidence lanes with weighted reciprocal rank fusion.
Graph neighbor retrieval is available when the configured provider is
operational. `GET /v4/capability` reports runtime availability. Context defaults
to one search; optional `adaptive` mode makes at most one planner call and two
additional searches while retaining the authorized scope.

V3 remains a compatibility API with a separate lexical-core API/worker Compose
topology. Its agent/session controls are not the V4 tenant/dataset contract.
[Root ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/ARCHITECTURE.md) is preserved historical V3 material;
[architecture-v4.md](docs/core/architecture/) describes the current design.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/docs/README.md)
- [API and SDK](docs/core/api-reference/), [CLI](docs/core/cli-reference/), [MCP](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/README_MCP.md)
- [Concepts and ingestion](docs/core/concepts-and-ingestion/)
- [Retrieval and graph](docs/core/retrieval-and-graph/)
- [Operations](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/docs/RUNBOOK.md), [offline projection rebuild](docs/core/rebuild-runbook/)
- [Security and privacy](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/docs/security-and-privacy.md), [vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/SECURITY.md)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/core/troubleshooting/), [capacity and limitations](docs/core/limitations/)
- [Ecosystem boundaries](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/docs/ecosystem.md), [migration](docs/core/migration/)
- [Contributing](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/CONTRIBUTING.md), [testing](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/docs/testing.md), [changelog](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/CHANGELOG.md)

## Limitations

Embedded storage requires one writer and deployment-specific capacity testing.
Rebuild is offline, storage-root-wide and disabled by default. Bitemporal
queries, associative PPR, hosted/distributed storage and legal certification
are not implemented Core guarantees. Evidence linkage is not citation truth.
Historical benchmarks and interrupted soaks are not v0.8.0 measurements.

## License

[MIT](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/LICENSE).

## Development checks

```bash
make test-local
# After installing dev + adapters:
make test-all
```

See [testing](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/docs/testing.md) for optional integrations and release evidence.

# Local quickstarts and V4 provider requirements

Run from the repository after `uv sync --locked --extra dev`. This uses one
combined process, no model loading and no external provider access. It exercises
V3 durable raw-memory and lexical retrieval. Canonical V4 insert is unavailable
in this profile: it returns `503 canonical_processing_unavailable`. V4 needs a
model-enabled combined consumer with reviewed extraction/embedding dependencies.

## Provision before startup

```bash
export MESA_STORAGE_ROOT="$(mktemp -d /tmp/mesa-doc-demo-XXXXXX)"
export MESA_RUNTIME_PROFILE=combined
export MESA_LOAD_DOTENV=false
export MESA_MODEL_ENABLED=false
export MESA_EXTERNAL_PROVIDER_ENABLED=false
export MESA_TIER3_MODE=0
export MESA_PRINCIPAL_ID=docs-principal
export MESA_PORT=18080
export MESA_API_KEY="$(.venv/bin/mesa-v4-admin issue-key --principal docs-principal)"
.venv/bin/mesa-v4-admin grant-role --principal docs-principal --tenant docs-tenant --role OWNER
.venv/bin/mesa-v4-admin grant-agent --principal docs-principal --agent docs-agent --permission SESSION_CREATE
```

Keep the issued key out of logs and shared terminal output. The commands write
only the new sample policy database. In another terminal inherit this same
environment and start one loopback server:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn mesa_memory.api.server:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18080
```

Wait for readiness:

```bash
curl --fail http://127.0.0.1:18080/health/init
curl --fail -H "X-API-Key: $MESA_API_KEY" http://127.0.0.1:18080/health
```

Readiness returns `{"status":"ready"}` on success; health reports store/queue
state. The normal launcher binds all interfaces internally; this explicit
uvicorn command limits the local example to loopback.

## Insert, poll and search

With the same environment:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m examples.v3_quickstart
```

The V3 example starts a server-created `docs-agent` session and inserts
“The demo archive opens at nine.” It polls raw-log status until `processed`,
rejects `failed`/`rejected`, and searches only that authorized session. Expected
summary: `PROCESSED; scoped V3 raw memory found`. No LLM extraction, embedding
quality or V4 tenant guarantee is inferred from this demo.

## V4 canonical example (provider prerequisites)

`examples/v4_quickstart.py` supplies required title/source/catalog IDs, freezes
one chunk, polls the mutation and checks source-linked evidence. It requires
`MESA_MODEL_ENABLED=true` and operational configured models/providers. Do not run
it with the model-disabled environment above. Install the needed `ml`/`adapters`
extras, provision reviewed provider/model/dimension settings, retain the same
ACL and one-owner rules, and launch on loopback. Follow [configuration](docs/core/configuration/)
and [installation](docs/core/installation/). The exact command after those prerequisites is:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m examples.v4_quickstart
```

This provider-enabled standalone example was **NOT EXECUTED** in this
documentation audit. V4 API/storage behavior is additionally exercised through
local contract tests with explicitly injected deterministic providers. Those
fixtures are not real-model evidence. `wait_until_committed()` can return failed
terminal states; always check `state == "COMMITTED"`.

## Restart and cleanup

Stop this example's server with Ctrl-C and restart it with the same environment.
Query the saved session/mutation while the session is active. Do not run two
writers. End the session only after retrieval; active-session search after end
is rejected.

After stopping the server, retain or remove only this newly created sample root
using your file manager. No generic database/volume removal command is provided.
If the port is occupied choose another loopback port and set `MESA_BASE_URL`
for the example accordingly.

# Installation and deployment

Bu rehber v3 lexical-core uyumluluk topology’si ile v4 full-cognitive release
candidate topology’sini ayrı tutar. Production kararı Final MVP Certification
tamamlanana kadar `NO-GO`dur. Repository `.env` dosyasını
kendiliğinden yüklemez. Gerçek secret’ları bir secret manager’da saklayın.

Doğrudan çalıştırılabilir model-disabled demo için [Getting started](docs/core/getting-started/) rehberini kullanın. Aşağıdaki `/srv/mesa` yolları operator örneğidir, otomatik kurulum değildir. Credential/ACL bootstrap runtime başlamadan önce yapılır.

## Gereksinimler

- Python 3.10–3.13
- Kilitli kurulum için `uv`
- Compose kullanılıyorsa Docker Engine ve Docker Compose

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA.git
cd MESA
python -m pip install "uv==0.9.6"
uv sync --locked --extra dev
uv pip check
```

`pyproject.toml` desteklenen dependency aralıklarını, `uv.lock` CI/Docker
tarafından kullanılan tekrarlanabilir grafiği tanımlar. Model adapter’ları ve
benchmark bağımlılıkları yalnız gerekli profillerde kurulmalıdır.

## Ortak ortam ilkeleri

```bash
export MESA_STORAGE_ROOT=/srv/mesa/v4-data
export MESA_LOAD_DOTENV=false
export MESA_LOG_LEVEL=INFO
export MESA_LOG_FORMAT=json
```

Storage root uygulamaya ait, yazılabilir ve açıkça seçilmiş bir dizin olmalıdır.
Repository, home veya filesystem root kullanmayın. V3 ve v4 için ayrı fiziksel
root kullanın.

## V4 combined runtime

V4’ün desteklenen storage-writing topology’si tek `combined` process’tir:

```bash
export MESA_RUNTIME_PROFILE=combined
export MESA_MODEL_ENABLED=true
export MESA_TIER3_MODE=0
export MESA_EXTERNAL_PROVIDER_ENABLED=true
export MESA_PRINCIPAL_ID=service-api
export MESA_PRINCIPAL_TYPE=SERVICE
export MESA_PRINCIPAL_STATUS=active
python -m mesa_memory.runtime_entrypoint
```

Bu başlatma önce credential/ACL kurulmasını ve model/provider bağımlılıklarını gerektirir. Local model için `--extra ml`; provider SDK gerekiyorsa `--extra adapters` kurulur. External `text-embedding-3-small` seçimi `MESA_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION=1536` gerektirir; local Magibu varsayılanı 768 ile karıştırmayın. Tam alan listesi [configuration](docs/core/configuration/) içindedir.

Provider’a özel adapter/model/credential değişkenleri deployment tarafından
sağlanır. Release adayı provider seçimi performans, maliyet ve güvenlik kanıtı
olmadan sabitlenmez. Model-disabled çalıştırma topology smoke testinde
kullanılabilir ancak full-cognitive production kanıtı değildir.

V4 credentials ve ACL:

```bash
export MESA_STORAGE_ROOT=/srv/mesa/v4-data
mesa-v4-admin issue-key --principal service-api
mesa-v4-admin grant-role --principal service-api \
  --tenant tenant-a --role OWNER
mesa-v4-admin grant-agent --principal service-api \
  --agent agent-a --permission SESSION_CREATE
```

Üretilen `key_id.secret` credential’ı secret manager’a aktarın ve runtime’a
`MESA_API_KEY` olarak sağlayın. Plaintext yalnız oluşturma/rotate anında
gösterilir.

### V4 Compose

```bash
export MESA_API_KEY="$(secret-manager read mesa-v4-api-key)"
export MESA_PRINCIPAL_ID=service-api
export MESA_MODEL_ENABLED=true
export MESA_EXTERNAL_PROVIDER_ENABLED=true
docker compose -f docker-compose.v4.yml config --quiet
docker compose -f docker-compose.v4.yml up --build -d
docker compose -f docker-compose.v4.yml ps
curl --fail -H "X-API-Key: $MESA_API_KEY" \
  http://127.0.0.1:8000/health
```

`docker-compose.v4.yml` yalnız `mesa-v4` service’ini ve tek v4 volume’ünü
çalıştırır. Aynı volume’ü başka writer’a mount etmeyin.

## İlk v4 catalog ve session

ACL verildikten sonra `MesaV4Client` ile catalog oluşturulur:

```python
from mesa_client import MesaV4Client

with MesaV4Client("http://127.0.0.1:8000", api_key=credential) as client:
    client.create_workspace(
        tenant_id="tenant-a",
        workspace_id="workspace-a",
        tenant_name="Tenant A",
        workspace_name="Workspace A",
    )
    client.create_dataset(
        tenant_id="tenant-a",
        workspace_id="workspace-a",
        dataset_id="dataset-a",
        dataset_name="Dataset A",
    )
    session = client.start_session(
        tenant_id="tenant-a",
        workspace_id="workspace-a",
        dataset_ids=["dataset-a"],
        agent_id="agent-a",
    )
```

Session ID sunucu tarafından üretilir ve dataset kapsamı sonradan değişmez.

## V3 lexical-core compatibility

`docker-compose.yml`, ayrı `api-only` + `worker-only` process’lerle v3
lexical-core topology’sini korur:

```bash
export MESA_API_KEY="$(secret-manager read mesa-v3-api-key)"
export MESA_PRINCIPAL_ID=service-api
docker compose config --quiet
docker compose up --build -d
```

Process’leri elle başlatmak için:

```bash
MESA_RUNTIME_PROFILE=api-only python -m mesa_memory.runtime_entrypoint
MESA_RUNTIME_PROFILE=worker-only python -m mesa_memory.runtime_entrypoint
```

Bu topology v4 Graph V2, dataset ACL veya projection-ledger garantisi sunmaz.

## Migration, backup ve restore

Migration yalnız uygulama durmuşken ve release runbook onayıyla çalıştırılır:

`mesa_storage/alembic.ini` içindeki `sqlalchemy.url` migration hedefidir;
`MESA_STORAGE_ROOT` tek başına bu URL’yi değiştirmez. Operator-reviewed config
kopyasında mutlak staging DB URL’si ve mutlak `script_location` tanımlayın.

```bash
.venv/bin/alembic -c /srv/mesa/reviewed-staging-alembic.ini upgrade head
```

Offline backup/restore:

```bash
mesa-recovery --trusted-root /srv/mesa backup \
  --source-root /srv/mesa/v4-data \
  --backup-root /srv/mesa/backups/v4-2026-07-23 \
  --stores-stopped
mesa-recovery --trusted-root /srv/mesa validate \
  --backup-root /srv/mesa/backups/v4-2026-07-23
mesa-recovery --trusted-root /srv/mesa restore \
  --backup-root /srv/mesa/backups/v4-2026-07-23 \
  --restore-root /srv/mesa/restore-v4-test
```

`--stores-stopped` yalnız compatibility/precondition input'udur; backup safety
authority'si değildir. Recovery implementation'ı storage writer lock'ını
bağımsız doğrular, canonical SQLite dosyalarını SQLite backup primitive'iyle
snapshot eder ve tamamlanmış staging'i atomik publish eder. SQL canonical
truth'tür; LanceDB/Kùzu projection'ları rebuildable derived state olarak
exclusive writer-lock boundary altında kopyalanır.

Restore her zaman yeni boş hedefe yapılır. V3 storage yerinde migrate edilmez;
backup sonrası ayrı v4 root'ta offline rebuild ve parity kontrolü yapılır.
Migration'lar forward-only'dir; başarısız release için `alembic downgrade`
yerine doğrulanmış backup'ı yeni boş bir root'a restore edin.

## Yerel doğrulama

```bash
uv run ruff check .
uv run mypy mesa_memory mesa_storage mesa_workers mesa_api mesa_client \
  --ignore-missing-imports --explicit-package-bases --follow-imports=skip
uv run pytest -q
```

V4 dar sözleşme paketi `tests/test_v4_*.py`, Graph V2 testleri ve
`tests/test_api_key_store.py` dosyalarını kapsar. Bu kontroller release kanıtı
için gereklidir fakat 24 saat soak kapısının yerine geçmez.

# MESA Core current V4 architecture

> **Package version:** 0.8.0; owner-approved source release, without production certification.

This document is the canonical architecture for the v4 release candidate.
Production remains `NO-GO` pending Final MVP Certification.
`ARCHITECTURE.md` and v3 ADRs remain historical compatibility records.

## Runtime boundary

V4 has one supported storage-writing topology: one `combined` process owns
SQLite, LanceDB and Kùzu. API admission and background consumers run in that
process. A second writer must never mount the same storage root.

V3 remains available as the lexical-core compatibility surface and keeps its
existing API/worker topology. V3 and v4 must not write the same physical
storage directories concurrently.

Canonical v4 fact extraction is owned by `FactExtractionService`. REBEL is not
part of the canonical v4 extraction path; references to REBEL in historical
architecture or V3 compatibility material describe legacy behavior only.

## Security and catalog hierarchy

The v4 security boundary is a tenant, not an agent:

```text
Principal
  └── Tenant
      └── Workspace
          └── Dataset
              └── Document
                  └── immutable DocumentRevision
                      └── SourceChunk
```

Roles are `OWNER`, `WRITER` and `READER` at tenant, workspace or dataset
scope. Roles inherit downward. Purge and rollback require explicit dataset
permissions. Agent IDs represent compute/persona context and do not grant
tenant access.

An authenticated session is generated by the server and binds one principal,
tenant, workspace, agent and immutable set of datasets. Insert, search,
context, status, replay and rollback derive their scope from this record.

API credentials use `key_id.secret`. Only the salted scrypt digest is stored;
plaintext is returned once by `mesa-v4-admin issue-key`. Multiple keys may
belong to one or more principals and can be revoked or rotated independently.

## Canonical ingestion

`POST /v4/memory/insert` durably admits exact source content and creates:

- one `MemoryCandidate`;
- one `memory_mutations` ledger row;
- one `pipeline_runs` row plus append-only events;
- ordered SQL, vector and graph outbox lanes.

The candidate explicitly carries tenant, workspace, dataset, document,
revision, chunk, source reference, evidence span, agent/session, pipeline,
extraction and embedding versions. Authorization fields are never read from
free-form metadata.

An authenticated dataset writer may additionally supply the typed
`legal_identity` object (`law_id`, `statute_code`, `article_id`, and optional
version/paragraph/clause identifiers). MESA validates it against the bounded
legal alias ontology, binds it to the immutable mutation provenance and stores
it on canonical assertions. Reserved `_mesa_*` keys in caller metadata are
always discarded, so free-form metadata cannot opt into legal ranking. The
producer remains responsible for verifying that the declared identity belongs
to the source; MESA_Data must not populate it from a bare article heading.

Validation is an explicit policy gate configured via `MESA_TIER3_MODE` (0 = deterministic-only, 1 = single LLM validator, 2 = dual-LLM consensus). A rejected mutation may keep its raw
audit source, but it cannot create an active SQL, vector, entity, edge or
assertion artifact. In Mode 0, deterministic admission checks gate progression with zero LLM validator dependencies.

## Pipeline and failure model

The legal success path is:

```text
QUEUED → RUNNING → EXTRACTED → VALIDATED → PROJECTING → COMMITTED
```

Failure/recovery states are `RETRY_PENDING`, `DLQ`, `ROLLING_BACK`,
`ROLLED_BACK` and `BLOCKED`. State changes use compare-and-swap and append an
event. Claims use a random fencing token, bounded lease, heartbeat and bounded
retry. A worker that loses its token cannot finalize the claim.

Projection prerequisites are enforced in the database:

```text
SQL → vector → graph
```

The projector only claims a later lane when its predecessor is complete.
Every lane is idempotent by mutation and physical artifact identity.

Legal citation retrieval selects trusted typed identities through the scoped
compound assertion index before lane ranking. Tenant, dataset, agent,
jurisdiction, validity and committed-state predicates are applied in that SQL
selection. Typed identity refines candidate recall and lane order; it does not
bypass deterministic weighted RRF or replace canonical evidence text.

## Canonical entity and Graph V2

Entity IDs use a fixed UUID5 namespace:

```text
UUID5(namespace, tenant_id + entity_type + identity_key)
```

`identity_key` is the normalized ontology URI when supplied; otherwise it is
the Unicode NFKC, whitespace-normalized and case-folded canonical name.
Resolution order is ontology/external ID, registered alias, canonical name,
then create. Collisions produce a deterministic redirect; historical rows are
retained.

SQLite is authoritative for `v4_entities` and immutable `v4_assertions`.
Kùzu is an idempotent projection. Assertions include subject, predicate,
entity or literal object, document/revision/chunk source, evidence span,
jurisdiction, authority, confidence, validity interval, mutation and pipeline
run. Assertion identity includes predicate, source and temporal context, so
different relations between the same entities remain distinct.

`CONTRADICTS` and `SUPERSEDES` connect assertions and preserve provenance.
PageRank only publishes observation telemetry; it cannot quarantine,
tombstone, delete or otherwise change retrieval eligibility.

## Artifact ownership and rollback

`artifact_registry` represents physical SQL, vector and graph artifacts.
`artifact_sources` allows several mutations/source chunks to own the same
entity or vector.

Rollback removes only the requesting run's source ownership. A shared artifact
remains active while another source owns it. The last-owner path writes the
SQLite retrieval tombstone first and schedules idempotent vector/graph cleanup.
An unfinished cleanup leaves the run `BLOCKED`, never falsely committed.

A new document revision does not erase history. Prior assertions become
`SUPERSEDED`. A legal purge retracts the requested source and removes only
artifacts that have no remaining active owner.

## Reconciliation and health

Reconciliation is bidirectional:

- ledger artifact missing from a store: requeue the missing lane;
- physical artifact without registry/ownership: quarantine it in the registry
  and enqueue cleanup.

`/health` exposes projection backlog, dead letter, stuck leases, cleanup
backlog, blocked cleanup, ownerless registry rows and shared-owner counts.
`/metrics` exports the same content-free aggregate gauges.

## Retrieval

All SQL, vector and graph lanes receive the authorized dataset filter before
ranking. V4 combines rank positions using real reciprocal rank fusion. Jurisdiction and validity constrain eligibility before ranking; assertion
confidence affects assertion-lane ordering. The bounded post-RRF legal factor
uses query statute/article identity. See [retrieval](docs/core/retrieval-and-graph/). Candidate assertion identity is the deterministic final tie-break.

Responses include document, revision, chunk, evidence, assertion, pipeline and
embedding provenance. PageRank is not a retrieval eligibility signal.

### Bounded adaptive context retrieval

The raw V4 search endpoint remains the deterministic single-query primitive.
The context endpoint and `mesa_get_context` default to `retrieval_mode=single`.
Callers may explicitly select `adaptive`, which runs the original query first
and invokes one semantic reformulation call only when the result is empty or
none of its top three candidates has support from at least two retrieval lanes.

The planner receives only the normalized user query and may return at most two
validated query strings. It cannot change tenant, agent, dataset,
jurisdiction, temporal or graph scope. New statute/article citations are
rejected. Every expansion reuses `MemoryDAO.search_v4_memory`; query rankings
are fused with deterministic RRF weights Q0=1.0, Q1=0.5 and Q2=0.5, with a
Q0-preserving tie break. Inner lane scores and provenance remain unchanged,
and outer `query_origins` plus `query_fusion_score` remain separately auditable.

An adaptive request performs at most one planner call and three total
retrievals. Planner or optional expansion failures preserve the original
retrieval. The deduplicated final candidate list enters the existing
`ContextBuilder` once, so the 2048-token default and atomic proof packing remain
the sole model-visible budget authority. This feature performs no answer
generation, recursive planning, decomposition or reranking.

## Migration and release

V3 storage is never converted in place. The supported sequence is:

1. stop writers and create a manifest/checksummed backup;
2. restore or copy into a new empty staging root;
3. rebuild v4 SQLite/vector/graph artifacts from raw sources;
4. run parity and authorization checks;
5. atomically cut over to the staged root;
6. retain the previous root for explicit rollback.

Production remains `NO-GO` until migration/restore, v4 Compose, crash,
saturation, cross-tenant concurrency, benchmark and 24-hour soak gates all
pass with production-like storage and the selected model provider.

Canonical V4 insertion requires the model-enabled combined processing consumer.
Model-disabled boot is topology/compatibility smoke and rejects V4 writes with
`503 canonical_processing_unavailable`; it is not a V4 insert/search demonstration.

# Concepts and ingestion lifecycle

## Identity and scope

| Concept | Implemented meaning |
|---|---|
| Principal | Server-authenticated identity owning keys and ACL grants |
| Tenant | V4 authorization boundary |
| Workspace | Tenant-owned grouping of datasets |
| Dataset | Source collection inside a workspace; session-bound access |
| Agent | Compute/persona context; not a tenant credential |
| Session | Server-generated principal/scope binding with immutable dataset set |
| Document | Dataset-owned source identity with a current revision head |
| Revision | Immutable source version with a frozen chunk manifest |
| Source chunk | Exact source content, ordinal, source reference and content hash |
| Assertion | Canonical subject/predicate/entity-or-literal fact with source evidence |
| Mutation | Durable admitted work and its state, separate from pipeline aggregate |
| Projection | Derived SQL/vector/graph artifact work with fenced claim and receipt |
| Evidence | Linked assertion/chunk/source span; not independently verified truth |

Catalog public IDs resolve inside the tenant. Physical storage keys are opaque;
passing a physical key as an external ID does not grant access. Agent and dataset
authorization are resolved from the session, never caller metadata.

## Admission and completion

`POST /v4/memory/insert` requires session, dataset, document, revision, chunk,
`title`, `source_ref` and exact `content`. See [API](docs/core/api-reference/) for bounds.
Admission returns `202` with candidate, mutation, pipeline-run and raw-log IDs.
This is durable admission, not visibility in every store.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> RECEIVED
    RECEIVED --> EXTRACTED
    EXTRACTED --> VALIDATED
    EXTRACTED --> REJECTED
    VALIDATED --> SQL_APPLIED
    SQL_APPLIED --> VECTOR_APPLIED
    VECTOR_APPLIED --> GRAPH_APPLIED
    GRAPH_APPLIED --> COMMITTED
```

The pipeline aggregate uses `QUEUED → RUNNING → EXTRACTED → VALIDATED →
PROJECTING → COMMITTED`. Technical recovery states include retry, dead-letter,
rollback and blocked cleanup. The SDK terminal set is `COMMITTED`, `REJECTED`,
`DEAD_LETTER`, `ROLLED_BACK`, `BLOCKED`; check status, not just method name.
Internal outbox/pipeline records may use `DLQ`; inspect each object's state.

Canonical `FactExtractionService` preserves zero-to-many extracted facts.
Validation mode 0 checks deterministically, mode 1 uses validator A, and mode 2
requires distinct A/B provider-model pairs. The runtime-selected policy is
snapshotted into admitted work; reserved `_mesa_*` metadata cannot downgrade it.
Rejected work may retain audit source but creates no active retrieval artifact.

Projection order is SQL → vector → graph. Separate stores do not share an ACID
transaction: fenced leases, receipts, ownership and reconciliation provide
idempotent convergence. A lost lease cannot finalize another owner's work.
Backpressure yields explicit admission errors; do not retry without bounds.

## Revision finalization and retries

For a multi-chunk revision set `finalize_revision=false` on all but the final
insert, with distinct chunk IDs and ordinals. The last insert freezes the
manifest. No new chunks may then enter that revision; the revision activates
only after every required child mutation succeeds. One document has one active
head. Create a new revision to change source content.

Use an insert `idempotency_key` (body field, <=128 characters) with the exact
same payload on retries. Conflicting payloads are rejected. Rebuild uses the
separate `Idempotency-Key` HTTP header. The SDK avoids unsafe automatic POST
retry after ambiguous failures; application recovery must inspect durable IDs.

`declared_content_hash` is the caller's whole-revision hash, `manifest_hash`
identifies frozen chunk membership, and a chunk `content_hash` identifies only
that chunk. Direct insertion does not establish a whole-revision hash.

## Correction, purge and rollback

Supersession retains historical assertions. A time-qualified query can include
eligible superseded evidence; an unqualified query uses active evidence.
Rollback removes source ownership; shared artifacts remain while another active
source owns them. Tombstones precede secondary cleanup; failure stays `BLOCKED`.
Purge requires dataset `OWNER` plus explicit `PURGE`; replay/rollback require
the originating scope and explicit `ROLLBACK`. Semantic rejection cannot be
reopened through generic replay (`409 NON_REPLAYABLE`). Non-head historical
rollback is a conflict. Do not edit store rows or leases manually.

## Producer contract

Core consumes exact content and identity; [MESA_Data](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/docs/ecosystem.md) owns source
acquisition, chunking and verified source metadata. HTTP insertion supports a
typed `legal_identity`; the current SDK `insert` signature does not expose it.
Use the HTTP contract for that field. Bare “MADDE 1” text is insufficient to
prove law identity. Producer metadata accuracy remains an external responsibility.

Canonical V4 insertion requires the model-enabled combined processing consumer.
Model-disabled boot is topology/compatibility smoke and rejects V4 writes with
`503 canonical_processing_unavailable`; it is not a V4 insert/search demonstration.

# Retrieval, graph and evidence

## Four lanes and scoring

`MemoryDAO.search_v4_memory` is the canonical search primitive. Tenant, dataset,
agent, committed-state, jurisdiction and temporal eligibility are checked
before candidate rank contribution. Physical vector IDs and graph assertions
must agree with canonical ownership/evidence.

| Lane | Candidate signal |
|---|---|
| Vector | Compatible `ASSERTION_VECTOR` semantic representation; query embedding |
| BM25 | FTS5 passage/evidence and lexical matching; scoped typed citation lookup |
| Assertion | Predicate, subject, object/literal, evidence, token coverage and confidence |
| Graph | Bounded paths from legal, vector, lexical and entity-name seeds |

For candidate `c`, `RRF(c) = Σ w_lane / (k + rank_lane(c))`, with ranks starting
at 1, default `k=60`, and all four default weights `1.0`. Duplicate backend hits
cast one vote. Ties use candidate identity. The source is
`mesa_storage/retrieval_scope.py`; runtime overrides are in [configuration](docs/core/configuration/).

Lexical exact citation +200 and same-statute +40 change the BM25/lexical lane
ordering. Assertion exact citation +150 and same-statute +40 change assertion
ordering. These are **not RRF score increments**. After fusion a query-dependent
legal factor is applied: exact statute/article 1.5, same statute 1.25, competing
statute 0.25, otherwise 1.0. A query without recognized legal citations has
factor 1.0. HTTP/SDK `final_score` is final fused relevance; higher is better.
`rrf_score`, `legal_factor` and lane `raw_score` are separate diagnostics;
MCP response adapters may expose a normalized `score` field.

Typed ingestion identity uses a bounded alias ontology and immutable provenance.
It improves scoped pre-rank candidate discovery, including article chunks with
little title context. Reserved caller metadata cannot opt into trusted identity.
This contract checks structural linkage; it cannot prove a producer attached
the correct law, revision or real-world interpretation.

## Graph bounds and failure behavior

SQLite owns entities/assertions; Kùzu is a projection. Search uses at most 20
ranked seeds and 3 hops. The DAO asks for at most 500 graph hits; the provider
bounds frontiers to 64 and per-node fan-out to 32, with bounded native fetches.
The default graph request timeout is 15 seconds. These are traversal/resource
bounds, not exhaustive multi-hop completeness or latency guarantees.

Graph evidence preserves path assertion IDs, entities, predicates and direction,
and is reconciled against authorized canonical records. PageRank is telemetry
only. `graph_mode=disabled` turns off this lane for matched ablation; it does
not disable canonical assertion retrieval or graph projection writes.
Responses expose bounded `scope_audit`, `graph_ablation` and `vector_lane`
diagnostics. Their hashes identify contracts/config/scope, not a certification.

A configured operational backend failure yields explicit `503` rather than
silently claiming complete search. Projection-only graph adapters have no
neighbor implementation and report the capability false. A request timeout does
not permanently mark the graph provider unhealthy. Custom embedding providers
are configured but non-operational until a successful embedding call.

## Context and adaptive search

`GET /v4/sessions/{session_id}/context` defaults to `token_budget=2048` and
`retrieval_mode=single`. `ContextBuilder` packs evidence once using `cl100k_base`.
The budget applies to formatted model-visible context, not the entire HTTP
response. If canonical BPE cannot load, the current OpenAI counting path uses
one token per UTF-8 byte as a conservative offline upper bound, even when
`strict=True` is passed. This may pack less evidence and is not exact cl100k
measurement. Exceptions raised by the counting interface propagate.
Complete graph proof must fit atomically; compact proof retains canonical
supporting evidence and may omit optional structural details.

Adaptive mode plans only if Q0 is empty or no top-three candidate has two-lane
support. It sends only normalized query text to one planner call, accepts at
most two reformulations, rejects invented legal citations and reuses the original
scope. Outer query fusion uses Q0=1.0, Q1/Q2=0.5. `query_fusion_score` and
`query_origins` remain separate from lane provenance. Planner/expansion failure
preserves Q0. This mode does not generate an answer or certify model quality.

## Interpreting examples

For a neutral single-hop “archive hours” query, inspect source evidence and
mutation state. For a multi-hop query, require every supporting assertion in
the path; a reachable entity alone is insufficient. An empty result is a valid
no-evidence outcome, not proof that a statement is false. Version/date-sensitive
queries should supply timezone-qualified `valid_at` or an interval and, when
needed, jurisdiction. These are request patterns, not measured benchmark results.

Core context packing is distinct from the independently sealed Profile B
context and scorer in [E2E Certification](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/docs/ecosystem.md).

## V4 capability

`GET /v4/capability`, uyumluluk için `features` listesini korur; liste aynı
yanıttaki değeri `true` olan `capabilities` anahtarlarından üretilir. Yanıt
ayrıca rebuild sınırını içerik veya fiziksel path taşımadan bildirir:

```json
{
  "api_version": "v4",
  "features": [
    "canonical_ledger",
    "projection_outbox",
    "idempotent_ingestion",
    "vector_retrieval",
    "lexical_retrieval",
    "assertion_relational_lane",
    "validity_interval_filtering",
    "graph_projection"
  ],
  "capabilities": {
    "canonical_ledger": true,
    "projection_outbox": true,
    "idempotent_ingestion": true,
    "vector_retrieval": true,
    "lexical_retrieval": true,
    "assertion_relational_lane": true,
    "validity_interval_filtering": true,
    "graph_projection": true,
    "graph_neighbor_retrieval": false,
    "associative_ppr": false,
    "bitemporal_query": false,
    "durable_rebuild": false,
    "human_review": false
  },
  "limits": {
    "rebuild_kind": "projection",
    "rebuild_scope": "storage_root",
    "requires_offline_runner": true
  }
}
```

`durable_rebuild` yalnız `MESA_V4_REBUILD_ENABLED=true` iken `true` olur.
`assertion_relational_lane`, SQLite’taki yetkili assertion ilişkilerinden
üretilen retrieval lane’idir; Kùzu neighbor traversal anlamına gelmez.
`validity_interval_filtering`, tek bir geçerlilik aralığı filtresidir;
bitemporal query değildir. Eski `graph_retrieval`, `temporal_filtering` ve
`vector_search` geniş adları bu nedenle sözleşmeden kaldırılmıştır.
`graph_neighbor_retrieval` yalnız Graph V2 provider startup sorgusunu geçmiş
ve son retrieval sorgusunda operational kalmışsa `true` olur. Yapılandırılmış
backend sorgu sırasında kullanılamaz hale gelirse search
`503 graph_backend_unavailable` döndürür; programming hataları bu sınıfla
maskelenmez.
Yalnız projection yazma interface'ini sağlayan adapter'lar graph configured
olabilir fakat neighbor-retrieval implementation'ı bulunmadığı için bu flag'i
`false` bırakır; bu durumda vector/BM25/assertion lane'leri çalışmaya devam eder.
`vector_retrieval`, embedding configuration nesnesinin varlığını değil,
runtime'ın gerçekten embedding üretebildiğini bildirir. Custom provider'lar
ilk başarılı embedding çağrısına kadar configured fakat non-operational kabul
edilir; beklenen provider hataları `503 vector_backend_unavailable` olur ve
başka bir modele sessiz fallback yapılmaz.

## V4 administrative rebuild operations

Bu yüzey yalnız control-plane `ADMIN` principal içindir ve fiziksel path veya
canonical içerik kabul etmez:

| Method | Path | Başarı | İşlev |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/v4/operations/rebuild` | `202` | Zorunlu `Idempotency-Key` ile storage-root operation submit eder |
| `GET` | `/v4/operations/{operation_id}` | `200` | Content-free state/progress döndürür |
| `POST` | `/v4/operations/{operation_id}/cancel` | `200` | Yalnız `PENDING`/`RETRYABLE_FAILED` operation'ı iptal eder |
| `POST` | `/v4/operations/{operation_id}/retry` | `202` | Güvenli `RETRYABLE_FAILED` checkpoint'ini tekrar pending yapar |
| `POST` | `/v4/rebuild` | `202` | Deprecated storage-root alias |

Flag kapalı submit/retry `501`, unsupported scoped alias `409`, invalid state
`409` döndürür. Yetkisiz status/cancel/retry operation varlığını sızdırmamak
için `404` olur. State akışı
`PENDING → CLAIMED → RUNNING → VERIFYING → READY_TO_CUTOVER → COMPLETED`;
yan durumlar `RETRYABLE_FAILED`, `FINAL_FAILED` ve `CANCELLED`'dır. Aktif veya
retryable operation sırasında mutation admission'ı `503 maintenance_pending`
olur. Offline işletim prosedürü
[`v4-rebuild-runbook.md`](docs/core/rebuild-runbook/) içindedir.

`Tenant → Workspace → Dataset → Document → DocumentRevision → SourceChunk`
şeklindedir. Revision ve chunk içerikleri immutable’dır; güncelleme yeni

İstemcinin verdiği catalog kimlikleri tenant-kapsamlı public ID'lerdir. Yeni

`manifest_hash`, dondurulmuş source-chunk manifestinin hash'idir; her chunk'ın
`content_hash` alanı yalnız o chunk içeriğine aittir. Doğrudan chunk insertion

`content_hash` alanı compatibility için korunur; geçmiş değerlerin provenance'ı
otomatik olarak caller-declared kabul edilmez.

| Method | Path | İşlev |

| `POST` | `/v4/sessions/start` | Sunucu üretimli, dataset kapsamı değişmez session başlatır |
| `POST` | `/v4/memory/insert` | Exact source’u kabul edip mutation ve pipeline run oluşturur |
| `POST` | `/v4/memory/search` | Yetkili datasetlerde vector/BM25/graph RRF araması yapar |
| `GET` | `/v4/mutations/{mutation_id}` | State, pipeline, artifact ve projection durumunu verir |
| `POST` | `/v4/mutations/{mutation_id}/replay` | Yetkili DLQ/retry işini yeniden kuyruğa alır |
| `POST` | `/v4/mutations/{mutation_id}/rollback` | Kaynak sahipli rollback başlatır |
| `GET` | `/v4/sessions/{session_id}/context` | Session context ve mutation provenance’ını verir |
| `POST` | `/v4/sessions/{session_id}/end` | Durable finalization ister ve session’ı kapatır |

Context çağrısı varsayılan olarak mevcut tek-sorgulu davranışı kullanan
`retrieval_mode=single` ile çalışır. İstemci açıkça
`retrieval_mode=adaptive` gönderirse sunucu, yetkili session kapsamını
değiştirmeden en fazla bir planlayıcı çağrısı ve iki ek arama ile sınırlı
semantik sorgu genişletmeyi etkinleştirir. Ham `/v4/memory/search` davranışı
değişmez.

`POST /v4/memory/insert` tenant, workspace ve agent değerlerini istemciden
almaz; bunları doğrulanmış session’dan türetir. İstek `session_id`,
`dataset_id`, document/revision/chunk kimlikleri, `source_ref` ve exact
`content` taşır. `202` yanıtı `mutation_id`, `candidate_id`,
`pipeline_run_id` ve `raw_log_id` döndürür.

Yetkili dataset writer, doğrulanmış kaynak kataloğundan gelmek kaydıyla isteğe
bağlı `legal_identity` nesnesi gönderebilir. `law_id` ve `article_id`
zorunludur; `statute_code`, `version_id`, `paragraph_id` ve `clause_id`
opsiyoneldir. Kanun numarası/adı/kısaltması yerleşik alias sözleşmesiyle aynı
kanuna çözülmeli, aksi halde istek reddedilir. Bu alan serbest `metadata`
içinden okunmaz; caller tarafından gönderilen bütün `_mesa_*` anahtarları
atılır. Kaynağın gerçekten bildirilen kanun/maddeye ait olduğunu kanıtlama
sorumluluğu producer/catalog katmanındadır; yalnız `MADDE 1` metninden kimlik
türetilmez.

Bir revision birden çok chunk içeriyorsa son chunk dışındaki insert'ler
`finalize_revision=false`, son insert ise `finalize_revision=true` gönderir.
Finalization source/chunk manifestini dondurur; bundan sonra aynı revision'a
yeni chunk eklenemez ve revision yalnız manifestteki bütün chunk mutation'ları
başarıyla tamamlanınca `ACTIVE` olur.
Chunk mutation'ları manifest dondurulmadan önce tamamlanmışsa finalization aynı
canonical activation bariyerini transaction içinde yeniden çalıştırır; başka
bir mutation transition gerekmez. Tek `ACTIVE` document head ve tekrarlanan
finalization idempotence'i korunur.

Search ve context işlemleri `jurisdiction` filtresini (ör. `TR`) HTTP,
sync/async SDK ve MCP üzerinden retrieval aşamasına taşır. Context HTTP
çağrısında bu alan query parametresidir; kapsam dışı ülke evidence kayıtları
canonical context içine alınmaz.

Search ve context işlemleri aynı temporal sözleşmeyi paylaşır:
`valid_at`, `valid_from` ve `valid_to`. Bu alanlar HTTP, sync/async SDK ve MCP
yüzeylerinde ISO-8601 değerleri olarak aynen iletilir. HTTP ve Python SDK search sonucundaki `final_score` fused relevance skorudur;
daha yüksek değer daha iyi eşleşmedir. `rrf_score`, `legal_factor` ve
`raw_score` ayrı alanlardır; MCP adapterları kendi response şemasında
`score` adıyla normalize edebilir.
Her sonuçtaki `retrieval_provenance.origins`, sonuca katkı veren
`vector`, `bm25`, `assertion` ve `graph` lane'lerini bildirir. Graph katkısı
varsa aynı nesne bounded `graph_hop_count`, canonical seed entity kimliği ve
SQLite ile uzlaştırılmış `graph_path_assertion_ids` alanlarını da taşır.

Context çıktısındaki retrieved session logları ve canonical memory, açıkça
`UNTRUSTED_MEMORY_EVIDENCE` içinde JSON evidence kayıtları olarak render edilir;
içerikler komut değil veridir. `token_budget`, yalnız bu LLM-ready formatted
context için normal durumda `cl100k_base` sayımıyla uygulanan üst sınırdır. Canonical
BPE yüklenemezse mevcut OpenAI sayım yolu `strict=True` olsa da her UTF-8
byte için bir token sayan conservative offline üst sınır kullanır. Bu sonuç
exact cl100k ölçümü değildir ve daha az evidence sığdırabilir. Sayaçtan gelen
exception ise ContextBuilder tarafından gizlenmez. `include_provenance` destekleyen doğrudan ContextBuilder çağrılarında
`source_ref`, document/revision/chunk kimlikleri ve bounded evidence span ancak
mevcutsa evidence kaydına eklenir.

Başarılı mutation yolu:

```text
RECEIVED → EXTRACTED → VALIDATED
         → SQL_APPLIED → VECTOR_APPLIED → GRAPH_APPLIED → COMMITTED
```

Pipeline run görünümü:

```text
QUEUED → RUNNING → EXTRACTED → VALIDATED → PROJECTING → COMMITTED
```

Mutation terminal SDK kümesi `COMMITTED`, `REJECTED`, `DEAD_LETTER`,
`ROLLED_BACK`, `BLOCKED` içerir; `wait_until_committed` başarısız terminalde de
döner. Pipeline/outbox görünümünde `DLQ` kullanılabilir.
Terminal/kurtarma durumları arasında `REJECTED`, `RETRY_PENDING`, `DLQ`,
`ROLLING_BACK`, `ROLLED_BACK` ve `BLOCKED` bulunur. Seçili validation
policy’sinin reddi aktif retrieval artifact’ı üretmez.
Semantic `REJECTED` mutation generic replay ile açılamaz ve yetkili replay
isteği `409 NON_REPLAYABLE` döndürür. Aynı pipeline'daki gerçek projection veya
cleanup failure'ları retry edilebilir; rejected child terminal ve parent
aggregate state'i doğru kalır.

## V4 Python SDK

```python
from mesa_client import MesaV4Client

with MesaV4Client("http://127.0.0.1:8000", api_key=credential) as client:
    session = client.start_session(
        tenant_id="tenant-a",
        workspace_id="workspace-a",
        dataset_ids=["dataset-a"],
        agent_id="agent-a",
    )
    accepted = client.insert(
        session_id=session["session_id"],
        dataset_id="dataset-a",
        document_id="doc-a",
        revision_id="rev-1",
        chunk_id="chunk-1",
        title="Neutral source example",
        source_ref="demo://source-a",
        content="Exact source text",
    )
    terminal = client.wait_until_committed(accepted["mutation_id"])
    if terminal["state"] != "COMMITTED":
        raise RuntimeError(terminal["state"])
```

Çok chunk'lı revision için ilk çağrılarda `finalize_revision=False`, son
çağrıda varsayılan `True` kullanılır. `search` ve `get_context` metotları
`valid_at`, `valid_from` ve `valid_to` parametrelerinin üçünü de destekler.

`MesaV4Client` ve `AsyncMesaV4Client`; capability, catalog, session, insert,
search, status, wait, replay, rollback, purge, context ve end işlemlerinin
yanında `submit_rebuild`, `operation_status`, `cancel_operation` ve
`retry_operation` control-plane metotlarını sunar. V3 istemcileri `MesaClient`
ve `AsyncMesaClient` olarak korunur. Dataset-bound MCP yüzeyi mutating global
rebuild aracı sunmaz.

## V4 authorization

Route katmanı şu bağlamı sunucu tarafında çözer:

```text
principal → tenant → workspace → dataset → agent → session
```

`OWNER`, `WRITER` ve `READER` rolleri aşağı doğru miras kalır. Purge ve
rollback için ayrıca dataset `PURGE` veya `ROLLBACK` izni gerekir. Agent bir
persona/hesaplama bağlamıdır; tek başına güvenlik sınırı değildir.
Rollback ve replay tarihsel yönetim işlemleridir; originating session kapalı
olabilir. Bununla birlikte principal/session ownership, mutation ile session'ın
tenant/workspace/dataset/agent scope eşleşmesi, dataset rolü ve açık
`ROLLBACK` izni her çağrıda doğrulanır.

Operator komutları:

```bash
mesa-v4-admin issue-key --principal service-a
mesa-v4-admin grant-role --principal service-a --tenant tenant-a --role OWNER
mesa-v4-admin grant-agent --principal service-a --agent agent-a \
  --permission SESSION_CREATE
mesa-v4-admin grant-dataset-permission --principal service-a \
  --tenant tenant-a --dataset dataset-a --permission ROLLBACK
mesa-v4-admin revoke-role --principal service-a --tenant tenant-a --role OWNER
mesa-v4-admin revoke-dataset-permission --principal service-a \
  --tenant tenant-a --dataset dataset-a --permission ROLLBACK
```

RBAC policy DB, Alembic yerine kendi `rbac_schema_version` metadata tablosuyla
v2’ye yükseltilir. Yükseltme aynı SQLite transaction içinde table-rebuild ve
row-count doğrulaması yapar; başarısız olursa eski policy tabloları korunur.
Tarihsel unscoped primary key daha önce iki tenant grant’ini çarpıştırdıysa,
kaybedilen grant geri üretilemez.

## `MemoryDAO` v4 sınırı

`mesa_storage.dao.MemoryDAO`, v4 için SQLite karar kaynağını ve LanceDB/Kùzu
projection’larını yönetir. Başlıca sözleşmeler:

- catalog/session: `create_v4_*`, `list_v4_*`, `get_v4_session`;
- ingestion: `record_mutation`, `record_mutation_extraction`;
- projection: `claim_projection`, `complete_projection`,
  `fail_projection`;
- pipeline: `get_pipeline_run`, compare-and-swap state ve event kayıtları;
- ownership: `memory_artifacts` ile `artifact_sources`;
- recovery: rollback/cleanup outbox, replay ve iki yönlü reconciliation;
- retrieval: `search_v4_memory`, zorunlu tenant/dataset filtresi ve RRF;
- observability: `get_v4_projection_health`.

Projection anahtarı `mutation_id + artifact_id` ile idempotenttir. Sıra
SQLite → vector → graph olarak veritabanı önkoşullarıyla korunur. Kùzu karar
kaynağı değil, SQLite assertion ledger’ının projection’ıdır.

## Graph V2

Entity kimliği sabit namespace ile tenant, entity type ve identity key’den
UUID5 üretilerek hesaplanır. Identity key önce ontology/external identity’yi,
yoksa NFKC + whitespace normalization + casefold uygulanmış canonical adı
kullanır. Alias ve external ID aynı entity’ye bağlanır.

Assertion; subject, predicate, entity object veya literal, source/evidence,
jurisdiction, authority, confidence, temporal alanlar, mutation ve pipeline
run provenance’ını taşır. `CONTRADICTS` ve `SUPERSEDES` assertion’lar arası
ilişkilerdir. PageRank yalnız gözlem telemetrisidir ve artifact karantinası
veya silme kararı veremez.

## İstek/SDK ayrıntıları

V4 HTTP insert ve sync/async SDK insert için `title` zorunludur. `title` 1..512,
`content` 1..32768 karakter, `source_ref` 1..2048, `evidence_span` en çok 4096,
`idempotency_key` en çok 128 karakterdir. Dataset session üyeliğinde olmalıdır.
HTTP `legal_identity` destekler; mevcut SDK `insert` imzası bu parametreyi
sunmaz. Public/source ID validator farkları için çalışan OpenAPI kullanılır.

Search request `session_id`, `query` gerektirir; query 1..4096 karakter,
`limit` default 10 ve 1..50, `dataset_ids` verilirse 1..64 ve session altkümesi,
`graph_mode` enabled/disabled'dır. ISO timestamp string'leri timezone offset
içermelidir. `valid_from > valid_to` reddedilir. Response `session_id`,
`dataset_ids`, `results`, optional `scope_audit`, `graph_ablation`, `vector_lane`
taşır. Sonuç provenance'ın varlığı source truth garantisi değildir.

SDK sync/async client timeout default 10s ve max_retries 3; yalnız güvenli
network retry boundary geçerlidir. API HTTP hata yanıtları `MesaAPIError`,
network `MesaNetworkError`, SDK schema `MesaValidationError` olur. Status
400/401/403/404/409/413/422/429/503 endpoint'e göre değişir; OpenAPI ve contract
testleri kaynak otoritesidir. Queue saturation/rebuild maintenance için
Retry-After dikkate alınır. Dakikalık default 60/minute, daily default 10000
principal bazındadır; health/metrics daily budget dışındadır.

List catalog çağrıları burada açıkça belgelenmiş pagination garantisi sunmaz;
response/schema'yı inceleyin. İlk catalog/ACL ve credential ön koşulları dahil
çalıştırılabilir örnek [Getting started](docs/core/getting-started/) içindedir.

Canonical V4 insertion requires the model-enabled combined processing consumer.
Model-disabled boot is topology/compatibility smoke and rejects V4 writes with
`503 canonical_processing_unavailable`; it is not a V4 insert/search demonstration.

trusted paths, locking, status, retry/lease, exit codes and retained generations.
Never use arbitrary raw-store cleanup as a CLI substitute.
[MCP](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/README_MCP.md) describes binding credentials, encryption and local
operator approval. `mesa operations approve/reject` acts on durable operation
IDs with server-side ADMIN authority; it does not bypass gateway policy.

`python -m mesa_memory.runtime_entrypoint` selects the explicit runtime profile;
there is no `mesa serve` command. `mesa-benchmark` belongs to the separate
benchmark project and is not installed by this Core package.

# Upgrading to v0.8.0

Package metadata is 0.8.0. Publication is owner-approved with the limitations in
the [release notes](docs/core/release-notes/); it does not certify production
readiness. Confirm actual tags in GitHub Releases. This guide describes changes
since v0.7.1, not a completed production migration.

## Preconditions and changed contracts

Use a stopped, backed-up storage root and rehearse on a new disposable root.
Record source commit, lockfile, provider/model/revision/dimension/normalization,
Alembic head, artifacts and rollback path. RBAC has its own schema version.

Since v0.7.1, the tree includes immutable revision manifest activation, opaque
physical catalog identity, declared/manifest/chunk hash separation, durable
rebuild operations/generations, provider identity, assertion FTS/representation
and typed legal identity migrations. Current source expects Alembic head
`d5e6f7a8b9c0`. Do not assume an old database is compatible just because the
package version stayed 0.7.1 throughout the development branch.

New insertion/reprojection uses `assertion-semantic-v1`; migrated old vectors
are `legacy-v0` and cannot contribute as current semantic evidence. Reindex via
the supported full offline [rebuild](docs/core/rebuild-runbook/). Unknown legacy provider
identity can be adopted only with external proof and a fresh unclaimed pending
operation. Matching dimensions alone do not prove matching embedding spaces.

Search/context carry temporal and jurisdiction filters; graph ON/OFF ablation
and bounded diagnostics are available. Context has atomic proof packing and an
opt-in adaptive mode. HTTP insert supports typed legal identity, while SDK
insert does not currently expose it. Invalid/frozen/idempotency-conflicting
source identity fails rather than silently overwriting. Semantic `REJECTED`
replay returns `409 NON_REPLAYABLE`.

## Upgrade and rollback sequence

1. Drain work, stop writers and take a checksummed backup under the writer-lock boundary.
2. Validate the backup and restore to a new empty staging root.
3. Apply forward migrations offline with the supported release environment.
4. Rebuild derived projections where required; check scope, provenance and parity.
5. Rehearse start, insert, poll, search, restart and negative authorization.
6. Cut over only with full release evidence and retain previous roots/generations.

Alembic downgrade is not the rollback strategy. Restore a verified prior backup
into a new empty root using the matching prior code/config, then validate before
switching traffic. V3 and V4 never share writable physical storage. Do not alter
official certification evidence as part of upgrade verification.

# MESA Core v0.8.0 release notes

**Release date: 2026-10-15. Package version: 0.8.0.**

The repository owner explicitly approved publication after reviewing the missing
certification evidence. This source release does not certify production readiness.
Actual publication and artifact status are recorded in GitHub Releases and the
release audit; a version bump alone is not publication proof.

## Verification and known limitations

- The preceding documentation PR passed both MESA CI and external release gates;
  the version/release commit is checked independently before tagging.
- Real model/provider boot/restart/token-cost evidence, a production-like 24-hour
  soak and new official Profile B certification are not supplied by this release.
- Full per-method docstring certification and the pre-existing full-tree Black
  formatting debt remain incomplete; required scoped CI checks are preserved.
- No local GPG signing key is available: the annotated v0.8.0 tag is unsigned.
  Signed-tag preflight success is not claimed. Build/SBOM/OIDC provenance status
  is verified separately and must not be inferred from publication alone.
- Production status remains **NO-GO** until the normal certification gates pass.

## Changes

The development history since v0.7.1 contains selectable validation, canonical
embedding identity, durable offline projection rebuild, immutable revision
activation/ownership recovery, four-lane scoped retrieval, graph runtime closure,
atomic evidence packing, bounded opt-in query planning and typed legal identity.
The current documentation refresh aligns entry points, API examples, provider
defaults, configuration, ecosystem boundaries and limitations; removes unsourced
showcase metrics/PASS output; and adds scoped neutral V3 and provider-required V4 examples.

Independent review corrected conservative offline tokenizer counting, low-level
vector versus canonical authorization, V3 router descriptions and smoke checks
under Python optimization. Dashboard build dependency lock patches address two
detected HIGH advisories; audit/build proof remains separate from production gates.

See [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/CHANGELOG.md) v0.8.0 for the detailed implementation
history, [migration](docs/core/migration/) for forward schema/representation
requirements, and [release policy](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/docs/release.md) for immutable signed tagging,
same-commit CI, provider, backup/rebuild and 24-hour soak requirements.

No new model accuracy, legal correctness, official Profile B PASS, native
MESA_Data delivery, production-size memory bound or 24-hour soak result is
claimed. Publication proof and exact test results belong to the release audit run
under `reports/v0.8.0-documentation-release/`; an absent tag/release is not success.

# Troubleshooting

Capture version/commit, runtime profile, content-free health, mutation/operation
IDs and error class. Never include keys, claim tokens or full source/query text.

| Symptom | Check | Safe response |
|---|---|---|
| Missing runtime profile/root | Explicit environment and CLI help | Use a dedicated writable root, never repo/home/filesystem root |
| 401 | Key registry, active principal, key rotation | Re-provision/reload authorized credentials; do not disable auth |
| 403/session conflict | ACL, session principal and dataset/agent binding | Grant intended scope offline; start a properly scoped session |
| Insert 422 | Required title/IDs, character bounds and content | Compare actual OpenAPI schema; keep exact source |
| Insert 409 | Frozen revision, identity/idempotency conflict | Reuse exact retry payload or create a new revision |
| Embedding 409/mismatch | Full provider/model/revision/dimension/normalization identity | Follow offline migration/rebuild; equal dimension is not equal space |
| `503 vector_backend_unavailable` | Provider availability and operational identity | Restore the selected provider; no silent model switch |
| `503 graph_backend_unavailable` | Health, timeout, Kùzu schema/parity | Diagnose query/backend and bounded traversal; do not advertise complete results |
| `503 maintenance_pending` | Active/retryable rebuild status | Follow [rebuild runbook](docs/core/rebuild-runbook/); no manual lease/queue deletion |
| Mutation stalls or enters DLQ | Projection predecessor, fenced claim, provider errors | Repair cause, then authorized replay if state permits |
| Semantic rejection | Rejection reason and validation policy | Treat as terminal; generic replay returns `NON_REPLAYABLE` |
| Cleanup `BLOCKED` | Store availability and shared ownership | Preserve evidence, repair store, run supported recovery |
| Readiness 503 | Worker liveness, thresholds, canonical backlog | Resolve health; process alive does not mean ready |
| FTS/parity error | Matching Alembic head and checksummed backup | Stop writers and rehearse recovery into a new root |
| Old Kùzu timestamp/schema error | Release code and offline schema migration | Upgrade/rehearse from backups; do not issue ad hoc ALTER or wipe |
| Growing RSS/disk | Lance fragments/versions, queues and retained generations | Measure representative workload; apply supported maintenance, reserve capacity |

Inspect `/v4/capability` before assuming semantic/graph availability. A model-disabled
profile intentionally lacks semantic generation. `wait_until_committed()` can
return failed terminal states; inspect `state` explicitly.

CLI `--help`, [configuration](docs/core/configuration/), [API](docs/core/api-reference/),
[operations](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/docs/RUNBOOK.md) and [migration](docs/core/migration/) describe supported
interfaces. Avoid raw SQL edits, in-place restore, forced queue completion and
unbounded retries. Real provider or production-size evidence unavailable in an
audit must remain `NOT EXECUTED`, never converted to a simulated success.

# Performance, capacity and known limitations

No v0.8.0 throughput, recall, accuracy, latency or 10–20 GB corpus-capacity result
has been measured in this documentation release. A unit/fixture smoke is not a
production soak, and bounded graph traversal does not guarantee complete recall.

The preserved [2026-08-27 Profile A report](https://github.com/Yasou13/MESA/blob/e3750a7c44c26d7e3555be755e8c07fd5282ca64/SOAK_TEST_REPORT_20260827.md)
describes an interrupted 6.47-hour run at commit
`b2ffc0bac6b1b417f53bc86f8e69e7b490fa88a5`, with 4,044 operations and growing RSS.
It is not a completed 24-hour release gate. Its future RAM-stabilization suggestion
is a hypothesis, not a measured repair. Old benchmark pages retain their original
conditions and must not be shown as current v0.8.0 proof.

`VectorEngine` maintenance defaults to 128 mutations and cleans old versions
older than seven days. Compaction, deduplication and executor cleanup mitigate
growth; they do not establish bounded long-soak RSS for every workload. Watch
fragments, version metadata, RSS, disk, mutation latency and maintenance failure
counts. Retained projection generations/backups are not automatically deleted.

Queue admission defaults are 50,000 pending records / 2 GiB, with tenant-aware
bounds and bounded in-flight/retry capacity. They are safety limits, not tested
throughput commitments. See [configuration](docs/core/configuration/). SQL writers are
serialized; one combined owner is required per storage root. Advisory local
locking is not a distributed/NFS coordinator.

## Compatibility evidence

| Area | Declared/configured | Current audit evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Python | >=3.10; CI matrix 3.10–3.13 | Local 3.10.12; other versions require CI |
| OS | No full OS support matrix declared | Local Linux; CI Ubuntu 24.04; macOS/Windows not exercised here |
| Dependencies | Ranges in pyproject, exact graph in uv.lock | Locked graph check and installed compatibility check |
| Storage | SQLite FTS5, LanceDB, Kùzu | Local disposable contracts; production-size gates pending |
| Local/external models | Explicit configurable identity | No new real-model quality measurement |
| Docker | Non-root full-cognitive image and two Compose topologies | CI/external deployment gates required |

## Unsupported or constrained

Bitemporal queries, associative PPR, human legal certification, distributed
writers/hosted storage, Ladybug backend, online or tenant/dataset-scoped rebuild,
automatic retained-generation cleanup and guaranteed citation correctness are
not current Core guarantees. V4 retrieval performs no answer generation.
CrossEncoder/legacy REBEL controls concern V3 paths, not canonical V4 ranking
or extraction. Adaptive planning is opt-in, bounded and not recursive.
